one.skip_reason: Raw hand-assembled instruction sequences written for the OLD architecture (reset ran directly from address 0). Since the BOOT_ROM+FLASH split (see Tests/docs/MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE.md), rv32i3stage_core_sim_test always boots through BOOT_ROM first (this test module needs its own BOOT_ROM_FILE generic, which it never supplied) before reaching FLASH at FLASH_BASE, not address 0 -- so even fixing that alone is not enough: this test module's own hardcoded PC values / cycle counts (e.g. pcs = [i*4 ...] assuming code starts executing at PC=0 with no boot delay) would still be wrong. Needs a real rewrite (new PC/cycle assumptions + re-padding the .hex to FLASH_BASE), not a quick parameter fix -- see docs/pt-br/bugs/per-entity-tests-ci-breakage.md.
